name: NetDebit for Paid Memberships Pro
author: Martin Berndt

sections.description:
NetDebit® is a professional payment solution for merchants in the adult entertainment industry and other high-risk sectors.

This plugin seamlessly integrates the NetDebit interface into Paid Memberships Pro. It is designed to keep the checkout process as simple as possible by removing unnecessary invoice fields and redirecting the user directly to the secure NetDebit payment form.

Key Features:

  • Full integration with the PMPro checkout.

  • Support for one-time payments and recurring subscriptions.

  • Automated webhook processing for payments, recurring subscriptions, chargebacks, and subscription terminations.

  • Automatic deactivation of incompatible trial periods to ensure compliance with terms and conditions.

  • Clean UI: Removes unnecessary form fields for a higher conversion rate.

  • Users with active chargebacks are automatically blocked from accessing content.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the netdebit-for-pmpro folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install the archive.

  2. Activate the plugin in WordPress under ‘Plugins’.

  3. Go to ‘Settings’ -> ‘NetDebit PMPro’ and enter your NetDebit partner information (PID, SID, Webmaster ID).

  4. Ensure the correct webhook URL is entered in the NetDebit project settings.
sections.faq:
Do I need a NetDebit partner account?

Yes, an active partner account is mandatory to earn with our payment plugin. Please register at https://www.netdebit-payment.de/webmaster/registration.

Which payments are offered be NetDebit?

NetDebit offers different kinds of Payments, SEPA transfer, Klarna, PrePaid and others.

What happens if a user causes a chargeback?

In case of a chargeback the user account gets blocked from making further payments and the subscription is deactivated. The user sees a message that s/he should contact NetDebit support.
As soon as the situation is resolved, the subscription is restored and the account is unblocked automatically.
sections.changelog:
0.7.0

  • First stable version for the WordPress.org repository.

  • Security improvements: Nonce verification for checkout and admin actions.

  • Security improvements: Input sanitization and output escaping throughout the plugin.

  • Refactoring: Updated webhook logic to use NetDebit SDK 0.9.2.

  • Compatibility: Tested with WordPress 6.9 and Paid Memberships Pro latest version.
